segments.t: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
segments.note: εἴ τις παράκλησις を「If therefore there is any exhortation」とほぐす

segments.t: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
segments.note: ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν を「each counting others better than himself」とほぐす

segments.t: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
segments.note: τοῦτο φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν を「Have this in your mind」とほぐす

segments.t: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
segments.note: τὸ εἶναι ἴσα θεῷ を「equality with God」、ἁρπαγμόν を「a thing to be grasped」とほぐす

segments.t: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
segments.note: σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος（11–15番）は WEB では次節冒頭で訳されるため、この節では対応なし

segments.t: And being found in human form,
segments.note: 「And being found in human form」は前節のギリシャ語（σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος）の訳。WEB では節境界をまたいでここに置かれる

segments.t: he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
segments.note: ἐπουρανίων・ἐπιγείων・καταχθονίων を「those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth」とほぐす

segments.t: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστός → Jesus Christ is Lord）

segments.t: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
Do all things without complaining and arguing,
that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
segments.note: φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες を「you are seen as lights」とほぐす

segments.t: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
segments.note: εἰς καύχημα ἐμοί を「that I may have something to boast」とほぐす

segments.t: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
segments.note: τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν を「how you are doing」とほぐす

segments.t: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
segments.note: τὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ を「the things of Jesus Christ」と訳す

segments.t: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
segments.note: τὴν δοκιμὴν αὐτοῦ γινώσκετε を「you know that he has proved himself」とほぐす。εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον は「in furtherance of the Good News」

segments.t: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
segments.note: ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμέ を「see how it will go with me」とほぐす

segments.t: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς が文末→前方へ）

segments.t: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
segments.note: τοὺς τοιούτους を「such people」と訳す

segments.t: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
segments.note: τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με λειτουργίας を「that which was lacking in your service toward me」とほぐす
